problem: Four identical plane capacitors with air dielectric are connected in series. The air breakdown field is 3 × 10^4 V/cm and plate separation is 0.7 cm. (1) What maximum total voltage can be applied? (2) What is the maximum total voltage if one is replaced by a geometrically identical glass capacitor with relative permittivity 7 and breakdown field 9 × 10^4 V/cm?
solution: (1) U = 4 Ea d = 8.4 × 10^4 V. (2) Each air capacitor may sustain U1 = Ea d = 2.1 × 10^4 V. In series all capacitors carry the same charge Q. For identical geometry Cglass = εr Cair, so Uglass = Q/Cglass = Uair/εr. Hence Umax = 3 U1 + U1/εr = 6.6 × 10^4 V. Glass is not limiting because Uglass = 3.0 × 10^3 V < Eg d = 6.3 × 10^4 V.
